card.name: Climate record time spans
card.fires_on: Words and numbers inside phrases that give a span of years for temperature or climate records, such as 'the last 100 years', 'between 1970 and 1998', or 'Fifteen-year moving averages'. It appears in climate-change discussion on the web.

modes.label: Year ranges
modes.description: Digits of years in ranges of climate warming periods.

modes.label: Last N years phrasing
modes.description: The word 'last' or the verb after a span like 'the last 100 years' in talk of warming trends.
modes.example: He emphasized that the warming over the <<last>> 100 years is very unlikely

card.writes: It pushes toward words about timing and duration and away from words meaning historical or over the years.
card.plain: It notices when text gives a stretch of years for temperature trends, as in climate-warming discussion.
